description: Update an existing dataset. Each of name, values, and tags is optional: a field left out keeps its stored value, so a rename leaves the table alone. Values sent become the entire table, so send the complete table including every row you want to keep; an empty table clears the rows. To add rows, call append_dataset_rows instead.

dataset.description: The fields to change: name and the table of values (data rows only — no header row). Leave a field out to keep it, or omit dataset to change only the tags.

tags.description: Tag names; a name the team doesn't have yet becomes a new tag. Omit to keep the current tags; send [] to clear them.

name: update_dataset
title: Update Dataset
